name: Different shell view - AI apps
author: miguel
description: Phone: like the ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity apps. A top bar (menu, your Wizard's name, workspaces), a left drawer (menu or swipe from the left edge) with your open apps, All apps and your chats, and the chat with its composer as the main screen; an app you open fills the screen under the same top bar. Desktop: the same as their desktop apps: a sidebar on the left (your open apps, All apps, your chats, New chat, Settings) that folds to an icon rail (Ctrl+Shift+S), the chat in a centred column with the composer, an app filling the page beside it, the workspace switcher top right and the orb at the bottom over an app. One shell view at a time: on turns Orb and Apps off; all off = Desks
